parsed.explanation: The write-up's own text names the missing step: 'Remaining crux: prove shrinkage stops (equivalently: finitely many permanents / S_infty finitely generated).' That finiteness is exactly ledger L6.2 (large-prime erasure / dependence on finitely many small primes). Nowhere else is it proved: the only support offered is 'Empirics (100+ values of a_1 ...): shrinkage ALWAYS stops', which is numerical testing, not an argument for all cases. Theorem A supplies the characterization (L6.1) and the conditional periodicity assembly, but both are explicitly conditioned on the unproved finite-generation lemma, so L6.3 also fails to follow. Closing the gap requires a new lemma, not a local edit.
